content: In a film and TV landscape where it feels like every other video game is getting an adaptation, we can add another (unexpected) candidate to the pile. Variety just broke that the ‘90s shoot-‘em-up series Metal Slug is getting a live-action movie. As you might expect, given that Metal Slug publisher SNK is owned by the Saudi Arabian government's Electronic Gaming Development Company (EGDC), the film is being made by the Saudi-backed production studio The Arena.
